Compatible saved semantic mappings/calibration drive preview; native session JSON can be saved/restored, but its target rest profile is not applied. DOC-031 verifies canonical FBX source identities despite loader mesh aliases and preserves original clip indices while skipping completely empty animation stacks; source bytes/skins remain unchanged.
